line_name: Wizara ya Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari
purpose: The whole estimate for **Fungu 68**, the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, for FY2026/27, as put to Parliament on 30 April 2026. The ministry separately projects revenue collection of **TZS 160,369,240,000** from sales of National ICT Broadband Backbone services (paragraph 57) — a receipt, not an appropriation, and not netted against the figures above.
scope_basis: Whole-vote estimate for the communications and IT ministry. Recorded `partial` under the envelope rule — a ministry's total vote is not digital-transformation finance — and held for the composition finding below.
funding_source: split on the speech's own face — development spending TZS 98,480,905,000 domestic (*fedha za ndani*) and TZS 110,962,374,000 external (*fedha za nje*)
amount_scale: shillings (units). The speech states figures to the shilling, e.g. `Shilingi 222,589,451,000.00`.
doc_locator: *Hotuba ya Waziri wa Mawasiliano na Teknolojia ya Habari … makadirio ya mapato na matumizi ya fedha kwa mwaka wa fedha wa 2026/27*, paragraphs 57–60
notes: The proposal is 23.6% below the prior year's approved vote, and the whole of the reduction is external money.** FY2025/26 was approved at TZS 291,533,139,000 (`tza-2026-68`); FY2026/27 asks TZS 222,589,451,000. **Domestic development finance is identical to the shilling across the two years — TZS 98,480,905,000 — while external development finance falls from TZS 178,566,578,000 to TZS 110,962,374,000.** The external share of development spending drops from 64.5% to 53.0%. Whatever else the cut is, it is not a change in what Tanzania is putting in from its own resources. · The dependency is the finding, not the total.** A programme whose declared purpose is digital sovereignty is still majority-financed from outside in the year it is cut, and the swing between years is entirely a function of donor and lender disbursement schedules rather than of any domestic fiscal decision. · Recorded `partial` and it must not be folded into a headline digital total.** This is the ministry's whole envelope, and the envelope rule bars crediting a multi-purpose vote to digital. · `amount_usd` left blank.** No named fiscal-year-average TZS/USD rate is held, and the driver forbids spot-converting a fiscal-year figure. · Stage is `proposed`, not appropriated.** The speech is the minister's request to Parliament; nothing on file records the appropriation. When the Appropriation Act or estimates volume arrives it merges into this record and resets the baseline (`wiki/finance-load-domestic-state.md` → *The five cases*), which is why `source_tier` is `official-statement`. · Built under `INGEST.md` step 2a** from 2026-04-30-tz-hotuba-bajeti-mawasiliano-2026-27, which carries the full verbatim speech.
